lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters positioned posterior to the gill region, arranged in staggered vertical columns with inter-blob spacing approximately 2-5 times the diameter of individual blobs.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersecting with circular high-luminance blobs, creating a grid-like node structure on the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Horizontal linear feature on the upper flank defined by a sharp vertical luminance gradient, transitioning from light-valued pixels on the dorsal edge to shadow-valued pixels on the ventral edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of five distinct vertical gill slits; secondary elongated dark objects located in the lower-center field of view representing symbiotic fish.
